headlines.text: White House withdraws Lance Schroyer’s nomination to lead ICE. The ex-Oklahoma state trooper’s nomination had stalled in the Senate as ICE faced growing scrutiny over its operations.
Former Assad officer sentenced to 60 years in US for torture. Former Syrian official sentenced to 60 years in US prison for torturing prisoners under al-Assad's regime.
Tunisia floods disrupt capital as heavy rain traps motorists and residents. Recurring floods disrupt daily life in Tunis, raising questions about drainage, transport and flood preparedness.
Iran expels Swedish diplomat in retaliatory move. Tehran gives Swedish official 48 hours to leave as Iran says Stockholm is bowing down to outside pressure.
Iran war live: Trump weighs ‘big decision’ on Iran, tanker hit in Hormuz. Trump says he faces a 'big decision' on whether to 'annihilate' his Iranian foes, adding that 'anything could happen'.
Migrant sea crossings to Europe drop sharply as deaths rise: IOM. More than 2,200 migrants died or vanished at sea in 2026, despite declining crossings into Europe, says IOM.
US approves $414M uranium investment in Niger, two years after troops left. Uranium project investment could mark a turning point in US-Niger and US-Canada relations.
Russia election: Could other parties challenge United Russia?. Russians vote for the first time since 2022. Can opposition parties challenge Putin-backed United Russia in this vote?
Trinidad and Tobago ends state of emergency amid pushback over mass arrests. Lawyers criticised mass arrests under emergency powers that allowed authorities to detain people without charge.
US judge orders 30-day notice prior to any Kennedy Center physical changes. The ruling comes amid legal battle over Trump’s changes to the Kennedy Center, including his effort to rename it.
Trump administration approves sale of F-35 jets to Saudi Arabia. The deal, which needs approval from Congress, comes as Riyadh seeks Washington's help in its war with Yemen's Houthis.
Yemenis recount journey to Djibouti as refugee arrivals surge. Djibouti has appealed to the international community to help provide humanitarian assistance as thousand flee Yemen.
US approves visas for top Iranian leaders to attend UN General Assembly. Iran's delegation to UNGA will be smaller this year, with travel restrictions and limits on luxury goods purchases.
Pennsylvania seeks CDC help amid dispute over US measles deaths. The CDC and officials from the US state differ over how four deaths should be classified as cases continue to spread.
Russia, China veto UN mandate to monitor Iran sanctions. Move ends the Security Council’s watchdog panel on Iran sanctions.

Meet the innovators under 35 shaping climate tech. Each year, the editorial team at MIT Technology Review puts together a list of 35 innovators under 35—a group of researchers, inventors, and other young minds worth following. Bills cruise past Lions to christen new home behind Josh Allen's five-touchdown performance. Highmark Stadium opens with underground heating coils, the world's largest snow-melt system and a 360-degree canopy as the Bills defeated the Lions.

Archbishop of Canterbury withdraws award from Muslim cleric after past Osama bin Laden praise surfaces. Maulana Hafiz Muhammad Tahir Mehmood Ashrafi received the Hubert Walter Award at Lambeth Palace days before past praise of Osama bin Laden surfaced.

Juror who blocked Lindsay Clancy verdict disputes fellow jurors' claims: report. Michael Desronvil, the holdout Lindsay Clancy juror, disputes fellow jurors' claims he expressed doubts about the prosecution's case during deliberations.

Brutal MLB collision leaves New York Mets first baseman Jared Young motionless on the field. Jared Young was stretchered off after Nolan McLean's knee struck him in the head during a collision on a Justin Crawford grounder at Citi Field.

Ms Rachel urges 'every wealthy White celebrity' to match Macklemore's donation to Palestinian causes. Children's YouTube star Ms. Rachel vowed to match singer Macklemore's $1 million donation to Palestinian causes and urged "wealthy White" celebrities to act.

Patriots' TreVeyon Henderson explains siding with family over DCF in custody dispute involving gender identity. TreVeyon Henderson defended his viral post about a Massachusetts family's custody battle over their daughter's gender transition during media day.

University event with Hasan Piker in Texas draws backlash from both sides of the aisle. Hasan Piker's planned UT Austin event drew bipartisan backlash from Ted Cruz, Greg Abbott and Henry Cuellar over his past remarks on 9/11 and Hamas.

ICE deports ex-Liberian fighter accused of torture, recruiting child soldiers. ICE removed Amos Sheik Massaquoi from the United States to Liberia over alleged killings, torture and child soldier recruitment during the civil wars.

Hasan Piker insists Middle East would be 'more stable' if Iran had nuclear weapons during Axios interview. In an interview with Axios, progressive Twitch streamer Hasan Piker said the Middle East would be "more stable" if Iran had nuclear weapons.

Alexandra Daddario stuns in gingham bikini months after split from husband Andrew Form. Alexandra Daddario shared stunning gingham bikini vacation photos on Instagram just seven months after confirming her split from Andrew Form.

Colin Kaepernick accuses NFL of 'colluding' against Macklemore amid 'Free Palestine' controversy. Colin Kaepernick accuses businessman Robert Kraft and NFL stadium owners of "openly colluding" to force Macklemore off Ed Sheeran's "Loop Tour" date.

Finnish foreign ministry official details how Russia's 'hybrid warfare' reshaped border security. Finland built 124 miles of border fencing after Russia allegedly weaponized migration as hybrid warfare against the Nordic NATO member state.

Virginia Governor Abigail Spanberger quietly rolls back Youngkin's plans to protect girls' sports. Abigail Spanberger's administration quietly withdrew proposed protections for girls' sports and female spaces like locker rooms and bathrooms in Virginia.

Trump's EPA reforms are a huge boost to manufacturers, but there's more red tape to cut: expert. NAM CEO Jay Timmons says Trump EPA rollback of Biden-era power plant emissions standards is a game changer but warns more permitting reform is needed.

Mike Huckabee calls out Macklemore on antisemitism: 'Voice' of 'Jew hatred'. Mike Huckabee backs NFL owners pushing to cancel Macklemore concerts, calling the rapper's stance pro-Hamas and a clear voice of Jew hatred.

Morning news brief. Trump threatens to tear down the Kennedy Center amid court battle, Trump's other priorities also get pushback this week, Poland's PM warns Russia could strike countries that support Ukraine.

What to know after a week of Houthi attacks that threaten Saudi oil. The Houthis' biggest land grab in years reignited Yemen's 12-year civil war and pushed up global fuel prices, extending their reach to a key maritime chokepoint and threatening Saudi Arabia's oil exports.

It's illegal for armed federal officers to be at polls. Lawsuits seek to ensure that. The latest lawsuit, first reported by NPR, argues the Trump administration's repeated suggestions that federal officers could be at polling sites is a form of illegal voter intimidation.

The driver who slammed into an LA bus before helicopter crash is charged with murder. An SUV driver was under the influence of drugs when she swerved into the wrong lane, blew a red light and slammed into a Los Angeles city bus, killing two riders, prosecutors said as they charged her with murder.

Trump withdraws Lance Schroyer, a former Oklahoma state trooper, as his nominee to lead ICE. The White House says it is withdrawing its nomination of Lance Schroyer, a former Oklahoma state trooper, to lead ICE, ensuring that an agency at the forefront of President Trump's domestic agenda will remain without a Senate-confirmed leader for at least a while longer.

ICE agent appears in Minnesota court to face charges in the shooting of a Venezuelan immigrant. Christian Castro, a federal immigration officer, made his first court appearance in Minnesota since he was booked Wednesday into a local jail. Castro faces multiple state and federal charges in connection with a shooting during the immigration surge in Minnesota.

Retired Olympic superstar Jessie Diggins wins her first-ever 100 mile trail race. This spring Jessie Diggins retired as one of America's most successful winter Olympic athletes at age 34. She's relaxing by entering 100-mile trail running races and navigating what comes next.

To prevent deaths in childbirth, Kenyan moms turn to an AI powered chatbot. Many questions come up during pregnancy. Is swelling normal? Are avocados safe to eat? For folks in Kenya who don't have a search engine at their fingertips, a chatbot is offering a lifeline.

A year ago, President Trump pledged to lower Medicaid drug prices. Has that happened?. The Trump administration's efforts to lower drug prices included promised changes to Medicaid. But it's still unclear which drugs will be affected. And each state has to opt in.

'American Scoundrel' traces Roy Cohn's playbook from McCarthyism to Trump. In Kai Bird's biography of Cohn, he looks at how the lawyer taught Trump how to deny, delay, attack, sue and countersue, never admit defeat, side-step paying bills and avoid a paper trail.
